headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 28, 2026**
article:
The Cleveland Guardians secured a thrilling 6-5 victory over the Cincinnati Reds, with Kyle Manzardo leading the charge at the plate. Manzardo's impressive performance included a home run and 4 RBIs. In other news, the Cincinnati Reds bounced back with a 2-0 shutout win over the Guardians, with JJ Bleday leading the Reds' offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Casey Schmitt of the San Francisco Giants, who was placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left knee meniscus tear. Other players on the injured list include Beck Way of the Kansas City Royals, Cole Sands of the Minnesota Twins, Kerry Carpenter of the Detroit Tigers, Spencer Steer of the Cincinnati Reds, Cody Bellinger of the New York Yankees, Shea Langeliers of the Athletics, and Mike Paredes of the Minnesota Twins.

The Detroit Tigers made a statement with a 14-0 rout of the Baltimore Orioles, while the Arizona Diamondbacks secured a hard-fought 8-7 win over the Pittsburgh Pirates. The Miami Marlins also secured a thrilling 6-8 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies. In roster movement, the Pittsburgh Pirates acquired Johnathan Rodríguez from the Baltimore Orioles in exchange for cash, while the Athletics traded for Scott Blewett from the St. Louis Cardinals.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Guardians in 0-2 Shutout**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a shutout victory over the Cleveland Guardians, winning 2-0. In the game, JJ Bleday led the Reds' offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Tigers Rout Orioles 14-0**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers dominated the Baltimore Orioles, securing a 14-0 victory behind a strong team effort. Eduardo Valencia led the Orioles' offense with 4 hits, including 2 home runs, while Troy Melton pitched 7 shutout innings for the Tigers.

top_news.title: **Diamondbacks Edge Pirates in Thrilling 8-7 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Arizona Diamondbacks secured a hard-fought 8-7 win over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Brandon Lowe leading the offense and Brandon Pfaadt pitching a strong 7.0 innings.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Phillies in Thrilling 6-8 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a hard-fought win against the Philadelphia Phillies, with multiple players making significant contributions to the final score. Impact hitters for the Marlins included Trea Turner, Justin Crawford, Otto Lopez, Heriberto Hernández, Esteury Ruiz, and Griffin Conine.

top_news.title: **Diamondbacks Shut Out Pirates 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Arizona Diamondbacks secured a shutout victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, winning 3-0. Gabriel Moreno, Max Kepler, and Jared Triolo were among the impact hitters in the game.

top_news.title: **Giants Place Casey Schmitt on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: San Francisco Giants left fielder Casey Schmitt has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left knee meniscus tear. The injury occurred on July 28, 2026.

top_news.title: **Rodríguez Traded to Pittsburgh**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles traded RF Johnathan Rodríguez to the Pittsburgh Pirates for cash on July 27, 2026.
